subject: Post-call: Pilot handoff & launch-readiness for Solstice Health
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@solsticehealth.com>; it-admin@solsticehealth.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Pilot handoff & launch-readiness for Solstice Health

Hi Julia / Solstice team,

Thanks again for a productive conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared alignment before we kick off the pilot: 

Top pain points you described
- High volume of short-form clinical note summarization with inconsistent templates across facilities
- Latency spikes when agents hit bursts during morning triage windows
- Strict PHI handling and audit log requirements for any vendor-hosted inference

Pilot goals (what success looks like)
1) 90%+ template consistency for generated notes across 3 clinic templates
2) Median inference latency < 250ms for single-request path under expected load profile
3) Full audit logs for all requests and automated retention to meet your compliance schedule

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks)
- Dataset: ~10k de-identified historical notes (we'll provide the ingestion script; you provide exported files via secure bucket)
- Evaluation: prompt set of 120 representative examples (we'll run daily evals and share quality dashboard)
- Owners: Julia (Solstice) — product owner; Kimberly (Redwood) — engagement lead; Sean (Redwood) — ops/onboarding lead
- Success metrics: template F1 on labeled examples, 95th latency percentile target, and manual QA pass rate >= 85%

Access & setup asks (items required to start week 1)
- Grant a short-lived service account with read access to the S3 bucket (instructions in attachment)
- Confirm who will provide de-identification: Solstice internal ETL or Redwood script? (If you want Redwood to run it, we need a signed data-processing addendum)
- Approve the pilot SOW draft (attached) or suggest edits by EOD Friday

Timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Access & SOW signoff
- Week 1: Data ingest + baseline runs
- Weeks 2–3: Prompt tuning, evals, and latency profiling
- Week 4: Acceptance testing and handoff runbook

Attachments: pilot-access-checklist.xlsx (bucket/service-account template), redwood-onboarding-guide.pdf, solstice-sow-draft.docx

Immediate asks for this thread
- Julia: confirm you can provide the service account by Friday and who owns de-id (internal vs. Redwood)
- IT Admin: please confirm the preferred method to share the bucket (cross-account role vs. pre-signed URLs)
- Sean / Kimberly (internal): we will follow up with an ops kickoff once access is confirmed

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

--
Attachment(s): pilot-access-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-onboarding-guide.pdf (PDF), solstice-sow-draft.docx (draft SOW)

From: Julia Park <julia.park@solsticehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: it-admin@solsticehealth.com; Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Pilot handoff & launch-readiness for Solstice Health

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap and the timeline. A few quick clarifications: 

- We can provide the service account; IT prefers a cross-account role if possible (less manual token rotation). IT Admin, can you confirm that works for you?
- De-identification: we'll run our internal de-id pipeline and provide the exported files; I can share the de-id spec by tomorrow.
- SOW: I'll review the draft and aim to get comments to you by end of day Friday.

A couple of small scope asks from my side: could we include one extra template (urgent-care triage) in the evaluation set? That will be an important use-case for our ops team. If adding that increases cost, flag it and we'll decide.

Happy to jump on a short ops kickoff once access details are settled.

Best,
Julia Park
Director, Product — Clinical Apps
Solstice Health
julia.park@solsticehealth.com
+1 (212) 555-0987

From: IT Admin <it-admin@solsticehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>; Julia Park <julia.park@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Pilot handoff & launch-readiness for Solstice Health

Hi all — cross-account role is preferred. We'll need the AWS account ID for Redwood and a policy template for the least-privilege role. Kimberly/Sean, please send the account ID and the minimal policy you require. Also note: we will only allow role assumption from an account with an executed DPA in place.

IT will also require that audit logs are routed to our central Splunk instance; if Redwood can push a delivery confirmation (SQS or webhook) after each batch ingest that would satisfy our internal process.

Regards,
IT Admin
Solstice Health IT
it-admin@solsticehealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@solsticehealth.com>; it-admin@solsticehealth.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Pilot handoff & launch-readiness for Solstice Health

Thanks — all helpful. Quick follow-up and next steps (action items):

- Kimberly (Redwood): I'll send over our AWS account ID and the recommended least-privilege role policy by EOD today.
- Julia (Solstice): include the urgent-care triage template in the eval set (we'll account for the additional examples in the prompt suite).
- IT Admin: noted on Splunk delivery — Sean, can you confirm we can emit the webhook/SQS confirmation after each ingest?
- Sean Gallagher (Redwood): please prepare the onboarding runbook and a short checklist for the ops kickoff (I'll schedule the 30-minute session once we have the role info).
- Timeline: if we get access and SOW signoff by Friday, we remain on track to start baseline runs next Monday.

I'll attach the role policy template and a short onboarding agenda in the follow-up email. Appreciate the quick turnaround — will reconvene after everyone has the requested items.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
